title: Add a product to cart and increment quantity updates totals
description: Verifies adding a product from the POS grid to the cart and increasing quantity updates cart quantity and totals in real time.

steps.description: Click on a product card in the product grid
Verify the selected product name is visible in the cart panel
Click the plus "+" button for that cart item

title: Verify line total changes after incrementing quantity
description: Verifies the cart line total/summary changes visibly after increasing an item quantity.

steps.description: Click on a product card in the product grid
Click the plus "+" button for that cart item
Verify the cart subtotal/total text is visible and reflects an increased amount compared to immediately after the first add

title: Add same product twice then remove it from cart
description: Verifies clicking the same product twice increments quantity and removing the item updates totals.

steps.description: Click on a product card in the product grid
Click the same product card in the product grid again
Verify the quantity for that cart item shows "2"
Click the trash/delete icon for that cart item

title: Removing an item empties cart when it is the only item
description: Verifies deleting the only cart item results in an empty cart state and totals reset.

steps.description: Click on a product card in the product grid
Click the trash/delete icon for that cart item
Verify text "Cart" is visible and an empty-cart message or zero total is visible
Verify the cart total shows "0" or "0.00"

title: Clear cart after adding multiple products and confirm
description: Verifies the clear cart function removes all items after confirmation and resets totals.

steps.description: Click on a first product card in the product grid
Click on a second, different product card in the product grid
Click the "Confirm" button in the clear-cart confirmation dialog
Verify an empty-cart message or zero total is visible

title: Cancel clear cart leaves items intact
description: Verifies canceling the clear-cart confirmation does not remove items or change totals.

steps.description: Click on a product card in the product grid
Verify the selected product name is visible in the cart panel
Click the "Cancel" button in the clear-cart confirmation dialog
Verify the selected product name is still visible in the cart panel

title: Cart totals update when adding multiple different products
description: Verifies the cart shows multiple line items and the summary total reflects the combined items.

steps.description: Click on a first product card in the product grid
Click on a second, different product card in the product grid
Verify at least two distinct product names are visible in the cart panel
Verify the cart subtotal/total text is visible and not "0"

title: Expired product is blocked or warns during checkout attempt
description: Verifies that attempting to proceed to checkout with an expired-flagged product results in a visible warning/block message and prevents completion.

steps.description: Scroll to the product grid section
Click on a product that is labeled "Expired" or shows an expiration warning indicator
Verify the expired product name is visible in the cart panel
Verify text "expired" or "cannot checkout" or "blocked" is visible
